Quick answer

Overview

  • Manufacturers that need a lead-generating site
  • Businesses replacing an outdated website

How much does website design & development cost in Coimbatore?

At Vintorex it is Starter ₹14,999, Growth ₹27,999, Premium ₹54,999, all excluding 18% GST. The wider Indian market range is ₹15,000 to ₹1,00,000, depending on scope.

What is included in each website design & development package?

Starter: Up to 5 pages, Mobile responsive, Contact & WhatsApp forms, Basic on-page SEO, 15 days support. Growth: Up to 12 pages + blog, Copy for 5 pages, Lead capture + CRM alerts, PageSpeed 90+, GA4 conversion tracking. Premium: Unlimited pages, Custom UI/UX in Figma, English + Tamil, Advanced technical SEO, 3 months free maintenance.

Who is website design & development for?

Shops, clinics, schools and service firms; Manufacturers that need a lead-generating site; Businesses replacing an outdated website.

How long does website design & development take?

7–30 days. Term: one-time.

What is not included?

Domain & hosting (add-on available); Paid plugins or themes beyond the included licence; Product or office photography.

How does the website design & development process work?

1. Discovery & sitemap: Goals, pages and competitors agreed on a call. 2. Wireframes & design: Home page design for approval, then inner pages. 3. Development: Responsive build, forms, WhatsApp and maps. 4. Content & SEO: Copy, images, meta tags, sitemap and analytics. 5. Launch & training: Testing on devices, go-live and CMS training.

Can I pay for website design & development in instalments?

Yes. One-time projects of ₹10,000 or more can be paid in milestones: 40% advance to start work, 40% mid-project approval, 20% delivery & handover.

How does Vintorex compare with other website design & development options?
